title: Manager, Engineering, Secure Build and SCS Services (East Coast Preferred)
description: About Docker Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout. We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default. _______________________________________________________________________ Secure Build builds and operates the infrastructure behind Docker's container builds. The team owns Docker Build Cloud and Docker Hub Automated Builds while developing the next generation of trusted build and CI capabilities. Its direction is to make Docker the trusted place CI runs: isolated execution, brokered access to secrets and networks, and verifiable evidence of what each build or test job did. The work spans Go services, container and build technology, cloud infrastructure, sandboxing and software supply-chain security, alongside the operational responsibility for production systems customers already depend on. SCS Services builds the backend systems and product capabilities that help developers understand, secure and ship software with confidence. The team powers important parts of Docker Scout and Docker Hardened Images, including the services and workflows that turn supply-chain data into useful developer, customer and agent experiences. Its estate is deliberately polyglot, with Clojure and Go services, event-driven workflows, Kafka, legacy Datomic components and newer Spanner-backed services. It also supports the customer journey around discovering, assessing, subscribing to and managing hardened artefacts. We are looking for one Engineering Manager to lead both teams. Together they sit at the centre of Docker's secure software supply-chain work: one creates trusted build outcomes, while the other turns build, artifact and dependency data into services and experiences used across Scout and Docker Hardened Images. This is a two-team leadership role with separate roadmaps, production responsibilities and technical domains. The teams should deliver independently, with explicit contracts and joined-up ownership where their services connect. You will own the health, delivery and growth of both teams and make the trade-offs that keep them effective as a portfolio. You will not be expected to be the deepest expert in every language or domain. You will need enough technical breadth and current engineering judgement to engage credibly in designs, reviews and incidents across both teams, set direction with strong senior engineers, and recognise when the right answer is to create space for their expertise. The kind of person we're looking for The successful candidate leads first. They are an experienced engineering manager who can inherit two capable teams, earn trust quickly and help each become a high-performing, value-delivering part of the wider Docker organisation. They are deliberate about where they spend their attention, protect both teams from becoming the second priority, and make portfolio trade-offs visible rather than allowing urgency, proximity or the loudest stakeholder to decide. They stay close to the technical work without trying to own every technical decision. They can hold a substantive conversation about distributed backend systems, event and data pipelines, build and CI infrastructure, trust boundaries and production operations. They are active in design and review, useful during incidents and willing to get hands-on where that moves the work forward. The balance still tilts strongly to leadership, coaching, delivery and organisational judgement. They care about security as a product and engineering property, not only as compliance. They understand how modern attacks exploit identity, secrets, dependencies and build systems, and they can reason about the evidence customers need to trust an artefact or workflow. They lead through judgement, clarity and unblocking rather than ceremony for its own sake. Above all, they grow the engineers around them and help both teams ship outcomes developers and enterprises can rely on. Responsibilities: Lead Secure Build and SCS Services, owning delivery, team health, growth, performance and operational excellence across both. Turn two changing roadmaps into a coherent portfolio plan with explicit priorities, capacity and trade-offs, and create leadership coverage so neither team becomes the permanent second priority. Partner with Product to shape strategy and roadmaps for secure build, Docker Scout, Docker Hardened Images and the services that connect them. Stay close to the technical work through design and code review, incident response and selective hands-on contribution where it adds leverage. Ensure each team's technical direction supports product, security, reliability and customer priorities, setting it collaboratively with Staff and senior engineers while leaving clear decision ownership with them. Own the interfaces between the teams, including trust boundaries, contracts, data quality, versioning, operational ownership and customer-facing failure modes. Balance new product work with inherited systems and on-call, and invest in reliability improvements driven by recurring operational pain. Own engineer growth and performance, handle difficult conversations directly, hire and retain strong people and build succession depth within both teams. Align Product, Design, Security, DHI Content, Registry, Hub, sales, support, commercial and legal partners while shielding the teams from churn. Lead disciplined use of AI-assisted engineering and communicate decisions, risks and progress clearly across UK and US working hours. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience 5+ years managing high-performing engineering teams, with meaningful responsibility across more than one team or distinct technical domain. 8+ years of professional, hands-on software engineering experience in backend, infrastructure, platform or developer tooling. Experience leading, growing and retaining engineers at or above your own technical seniority, including teams you did not build and difficult performance conversations. A leader-first operating model, with current enough technical judgement to participate in design and review across unfamiliar systems without needing to be the best engineer in the room. Experience prioritising across competing roadmaps, operational load and stakeholder commitments, with clear mechanisms for allocating attention and capacity. Strong backend and distributed-systems judgement, including APIs, event-driven architectures, data stores, cloud-native infrastructure and production operations. Understanding of CI or build-system internals, containers and artefact workflows, plus a strong interest in software supply-chain security and trust boundaries. Experience leading teams that operate production infrastructure through on-call, incident response, observability, SLOs and the work required to reduce recurring operational load. Strong product judgement and evidence of shaping roadmaps with Product rather than only receiving requirements. Clear written and verbal communication, strong cross-functional influence, customer closeness and comfort leading a remote-first organisation across European and US time zones. Helpful, but Not Required Experience with Go, Clojure or both, and evidence of becoming effective across a polyglot estate. Experience with Kafka, Spanner, Datomic or comparable event-streaming and distributed-data systems. Experience with OCI, BuildKit, Buildx, GitHub Actions or comparable build and CI platforms. Experience with sandboxing, microVMs, untrusted workload execution or multi-tenant infrastructure. Experience with SLSA, in-toto, SBOMs, VEX, Sigstore, cosign, provenance, signing or vulnerability scanning. Experience evolving legacy systems while shipping new capability for developer tools, security products, regulated customers or software-agent workflows. What to expect First 30 days Build relationships with every engineer and the Product partners for both teams before changing structure, process or roadmap. Understand Secure Build's product direction, production estate and on-call load, including Docker Build Cloud and Docker Hub Automated Builds. Understand the SCS Services products, customers, architecture and operational profile, and map the dependencies, trust boundaries and ownership lines between the teams. First 90 days. Own a coherent portfolio plan with both teams and Product, including explicit capacity for roadmap, reliability and cross-team work. Establish a sustainable operating cadence and leadership coverage that prevents either team depending on your constant presence. Agree ownership and escalation paths for shared services and failures, start one material improvement in each team and make progress and risk visible. One year Outlook Both teams deliver predictably against a portfolio that connects secure build, Scout and Docker Hardened Images outcomes without collapsing their distinct missions. Secure Build has delivered material trusted-build or secure-CI capability and reduced operational risk in its inherited production systems. SCS Services has delivered material customer outcomes, while both teams have sustainable on-call, clearer ownership and senior engineers leading broader work. Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis based on business needs. Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break. Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success. title: Product Manager, Homepage
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right. Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products. Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why. Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order. Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest: Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant. You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them. You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now. You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions. You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own. You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next. You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all). You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype. Next steps The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us! Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash . title: Senior Product Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are </strong></p> <p>Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at <a href="https://verve.com/">verve.com</a>.<strong><br></strong></p></div><p style="text-align: left;">Verve is a global ad-tech company that owns and operates a fully integrated advertising stack, spanning demand, supply, and data. While most companies in our space specialize in one layer of the ecosystem, we own the DSP, the SSP, and the data and identity infrastructure that connects them. This means our technology works end to end, in real time, every time a user opens an app or loads a screen.</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><br>We reach 2.5 billion consumers across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. Our platform processes billions of signals daily, enabling advertisers to plan and execute campaigns with precision and publishers to manage and monetize their inventory effectively. As the digital advertising landscape shifts away from walled gardens and third-party identifiers, Verve is focused on building the infrastructure that supports a more open, accountable internet. That is what drives the work we do.</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><br><strong>About the Position</strong><br>We are seeking a results-driven Senior Product Manager / Product Manager to own key commercial and technical areas of Verve’s core programmatic Marketplace. In this role you will lead cross-functional product execution alongside engineering, yield, commercial, and operations teams. You will be responsible for moving product initiatives from intake to structured execution, driving measurable improvements in our marketplace performance, publisher yield, and DSP spend velocity. Depending on your background and expertise, you will take ownership of one of our core exchange focus areas.</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><br><strong>Position Responsibilities</strong><br>● Product Strategy & Execution: Own feature discovery, product requirements (PRDs), user stories, and clearly define the acceptance criteria.<br>● Commercial Prioritization: Apply prioritization models, to prioritize you team's backlogs based on revenue impact, margin protection, and operational efficiency.<br>● Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner directly with Tech Leads and Engineering Managers to transition squad prior from technical hygiene to commercial ROI.<br>● Performance Analytics: Monitor exchange KPIs to identify revenue challenges, new feature issues or new growth opportunities.<br>● Product Release Management: Lead release cycles across cross-functional teams, ensuring clear documentation, enablement, and internal communication</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><br><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong><br>● Clear, commercially prioritized backlog in Jira driven by business ROI rather than reactive tech tasks.<br>● Delivery of high-impact exchange features that unblock buyer spend, improve yield, or streamline publisher onboarding.<br>● Seamless cross-functional alignment between Engineering Tech Leads, Product Leadership, Commercials teams and Yield Ops.</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><br><strong>Position Requirements</strong><br>● Experience: 2+ years (Product Manager) or 4+ years (Senior Product Manager) of hands-on product management experience in Programmatic Advertising (SSPs, Ad Exchanges, DSPs, or Ad Servers).<br>● Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of OpenRTB protocols, RTB auction mechanics, supply chain transparency and digital ad formats.<br>● Operational experience: Demonstrated experience using structured prioritization frameworks (e.g., RICE) and Agile development methodologies.<br>● Analytical Skills: Strong ability to interpret high-volume bidstream insights into tangible feature plans.<br>● Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.<br>● Optional skills (A plus): Mobile apps monetization SDK, Platform insights and analytics dashboards, mobile / web ad server technologies, Campaign management UI/UX experience.</p> <p style="text-align: left;"> </p> <p style="text-align: religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.</p> <p> </p> <p>Verve does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from external recruiting agencies or search firms for this role. Any resumes submitted without a signed agreement in place will be considered the property of Verve, and no fee will be owed for any resulting hire.</p> <p style="text-align: left;"></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Verve provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. <br><br>If you are a California resident subject to the California Consumer Privacy Act, <a href="https://verve.com/california-applicant-privacy-notice/" target="_blank">click here</a> to understand how Verve processes your personal information and how you can exercise your rights.<br></span><span style="font-size: 8pt;">If you are located in the EU or UK visit our </span><a style="font-size: 8pt;" href="https://verve.com/applicant-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">privacy policy</a><span style="font-size: 8pt;"> to understand how Verve processes your personal information and how you can exercise your rights.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We have expanded beyond retail into hospitality, media, healthcare, and business services.</p> <p>You will go after some of the largest brands in the world, including Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies, prospecting your way in and taking full responsibility for your pipeline target.</p> <p>Most of these companies run separate tools for email, SMS, customer data, and service. We win by bringing it all onto one platform and getting the customer to results faster. Once they are live, you will keep growing the account and lead the renewal.</p> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Prospect your own territory.</strong> Research every account, find a way in, and build relationships where Klaviyo has none today. BDR, marketing, and partner leads add to the pipeline you build.</li> <li><strong>Be the CEO of your territory.</strong> Build a plan for every named account, create and prospect into a relationship map, and pull in solutions engineering, value management, partners, and marketing at the right time.</li> <li><strong>Run business-value discovery.</strong> Find the real problem, put a number on it with the customer, and build a business case for the full platform that their finance team will support.</li> <li><strong>Sell to the full buying committee.</strong> Get to the CMO, CFO, CIO or CDO. Travel is coordinated in advance.</em></p> <p><strong>Get to Know Klaviyo</strong></p> <p>We’re Klaviyo (pronounced clay-vee-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we’re developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. title: Lead Bid Manager, UK&I (Public Sector technology)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><p><strong>Lead Bid Manager, UK & Ireland</strong></p> <p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <p>As a Lead Bid Manager, you will lead Axon’s most complex and highest-impact RFP and tender responses, proposals, and other customer-facing selling documents across the UK and Ireland. You’ll be a member of a global team that supports Axon sales worldwide and will serve as the senior proposal execution lead for the region. You will own proposal development from early procurement engagement through submission and evaluation-period follow-up, translating established win strategy into a controlled response plan and ensuring the final submission is compliant, responsive, scorable, customer-focused, and on time. Your strengths in judgment under ambiguity, cross-functional leadership, technical and proposal writing, and compliance discipline will be central to success.</p> <p>Focused primarily on UK and Ireland public-sector opportunities, you will work closely with Sales, Bid Strategy, Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, Security, Pricing, Finance, Services, and executive stakeholders. You will personally lead the hardest pursuits while also strengthening regional proposal readiness, reusable standards, coaching, and execution across bids owned by other Proposal Managers. This is an office-based position in the United Kingdom.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do </strong></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> hybrid schedule of Monday working remotely, and Tue-Fri in our London office<br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Director, Global Proposals<br><strong>Direct Reports:</strong> N/A</p> <p>At Axon, the Lead Proposal Manager is the senior owner of proposal execution for the region’s most complex pursuits. You will engage early in the procurement process, establish how the response will be run, make execution and compliance decisions within approved boundaries, and carry the proposal through submission and evaluation-period deliverables. This is a comprehensive individual-contributor role requiring expertise in the following areas:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Proposal Planning & Execution:</strong> Translate established win strategy into an executable response architecture, including workstreams, assignments, proof collection, review cadence, decision gates, and submission-readiness criteria. Build pre-bid readiness for anticipated strategic procurements with Sales and Bid Strategy. Drive resolution of product exceptions, compliance issues, and proposal commitments through the appropriate approval paths, while partnering with Sales, Bid Strategy, Pricing, and leadership on commercial, account-strategy, and bid decisions.</li> <li><strong>Team Leadership:</strong> Lead large cross-functional teams across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, Security, Pricing, Finance, Services, Proposal Team members, and executive stakeholders. Drive decisions, close gaps, enforce deadlines, adjudicate conflicting review input, and coach Proposal Managers and Specialists to improve execution judgment, compliance discipline, and independent ownership.</li> <li><strong>Project & Compliance Management:</strong> Own proposal governance, milestones, compliance traceability, mandatory requirements, forms, schedules, portals, review cycles, final packaging, and submission readiness. Identify and manage disqualification and responsiveness risks, and preserve proposal context through structured handoff of assumptions, exceptions, commitments, and unresolved risks during clarification, presentation, and other evaluation-period activity.</li> <li><strong>Proposal Writing & Solution Fluency:</strong> Develop technical and solution fluency to challenge weak claims, identify risk, and frame partial or non-compliant requirements carefully. Write, edit, and integrate high-value content when SME inputs are incomplete, inconsistent, overly technical, or insufficiently responsive, producing a coherent response for technical and non-technical evaluators.</li> <li><strong>Regional Leadership & Stakeholder Collaboration:</strong> Build strong operating relationships with UK and Ireland Sales and technical leaders, monitor regional delivery health, identify where pursuits need additional support or escalation, and provide Proposal Leadership with recommendations on complex-pursuit routing and resourcing. Identify repeatable success and failure patterns and improve regional execution through reusable standards, tools, proof sources, training, and workflow changes.</li> </ul> <p>What You Bring</p> <ul> <li>Typically 8+ years of proposal, bid, tender, or comparable pursuit experience, including repeated end-to-end ownership of large, ambiguous, high-stakes submissions with significant cross-functional stakeholder load and formal review cycles.</li> <li>Strong UK public-sector tender experience, including procurement routes, evaluation structures, frameworks and call-offs, mandatory requirements, submission mechanics, and evaluator expectations.</li> <li>Experience with major policing, blue-light/public safety, central government, defence/security, justice, or complex public-sector technology procurements is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience leading responses with strict compliance, controlled submission, and potential disqualification or non-responsive risk, with sound judgment about execution tradeoffs, prioritization of competing risks and deadlines, and when Product, Legal, Pricing, or strategy approval is required.</li> <li>Excellent proposal writing and editing skills, combined with the technical learning agility to challenge claims, identify solution risk, and turn uneven or highly technical inputs into clear, evaluator-focused, defensible content.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority, handle constructive conflict, and escalate with clear options and a recommended path.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to improve proposal execution beyond personally owned bids through standards, tools, processes, training, proof sources, or other reusable practices.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to coach Proposal Managers or other proposal practitioners and improve their independent execution quality.</li> <li>Comfort with Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, Salesforce or comparable CRM, proposal-management platforms such as QorusDocs, Responsive/RFPIO, or Qvidian, and AI-enabled workflow tools. title: Frontier Agent Engineering Manager, Enterprise
description: <h2><strong>About Scale AI</strong></h2> <p>Scale AI is the data foundation for AI, helping organizations build and deploy reliable production AI applications. We partner with leading enterprises and government organizations to accelerate their AI initiatives through our data annotation platform, generative AI solutions, and enterprise AI capabilities.</p> <h2><strong>Role Overview</strong></h2> <p>As a Forward Deployed AI Engineering Manager on our Enterprise team, you'll be the technical bridge between Scale AI's cutting-edge AI capabilities and our most strategic customers. You'll work with enterprise clients to understand their unique challenges, lead a team that architects specific AI solutions, and ensure successful deployment and adoption of AI systems in production environments.</p> <p>This is a Management role that combines deep engineering and AI expertise, leading a team, and working on customer-facing problems. You'll work directly with customer engineering teams to integrate AI into their critical workflows.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Customer Integration & Deployment</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner directly with enterprise customers to understand their technical infrastructure, data pipelines, and business requirements</li> <li>Design and implement custom integrations between Scale AI's platform and customer data environments (cloud platforms, data warehouses, internal APIs)</li> <li>Build robust data connectors and ETL pipelines to ingest, process, and prepare customer data for AI workflows</li> <li>Deploy and configure AI models and agents within customer security and compliance boundaries</li> </ul> <h3><strong>AI Agent Development</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Develop production-grade AI agents tailored to customer use cases across domains like customer support, data analysis, content generation, and workflow automation</li> <li>Architect multi-agent systems that orchestrate between different models, tools, and data sources</li> <li>Implement evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance and iterate toward business objectives</li> <li>Design human-in-the-loop workflows and feedback mechanisms for continuous agent improvement</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Prompt Engineering & Optimization</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Create sophisticated prompt engineering strategies optimized for customer-specific domains and data</li> <li>Build and maintain prompt libraries, templates, and best practices for customer use cases</li> <li>Conduct systematic prompt experimentation and A/B testing to improve model outputs</li> <li>Implement RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) systems and fine-tuning pipelines where appropriate</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Leadership & Collaboration</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the Engineering Manager and technical point of contact for strategic enterprise accounts</li> <li>Lead a team that is collaborating with customer data scientists, ML engineers, and software developers to ensure smooth integration</li> <li>Work closely with Scale's product and engineering teams to translate customer needs into product improvements</li> <li>Document technical architectures, integration patterns, and best practices</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Problem Solving & Innovation</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Debug complex technical issues across the entire stack, from data pipelines to model outputs</li> <li>Rapidly prototype solutions to unblock customers and prove out new use cases</li> <li>Stay current on the latest AI/ML research and tools, bringing innovative approaches to customer problems</li> <li>Identify opportunities for productization based on common customer patterns</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years of software engineering experience with 3+ yrs of </strong> <strong>Management experience </strong>with strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and system design</li> <li><strong>Production Python expertise</strong> with experience in modern ML/AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, HuggingFace, OpenAI API)</li> <li><strong>Experience with cloud platforms</strong> (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern data infrastructure</li> <li><strong>Strong problem-solving skills</strong> with the ability to navigate ambiguous requirements and rapidly iterate toward solutions</li> <li><strong>Excellent communication skills</strong> with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h2> <p><em>Agent Development Wiz</em></p> <ul> <li>Deep understanding of LLMs including prompting techniques, embeddings, and RAG architectures</li> <li>Experience building and deploying AI agents or autonomous systems in production</li> <li>Knowledge of vector databases and semantic search systems</li> <li>Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects</li> </ul> <p><em>Infrastructure Guru</em></p> <ul> <li>Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines</li> <li>Experience using Terraform, Bicep, or other Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools</li> <li>Previous work in a devops, platform, or infra role</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA)</li> </ul> <p><em>Customer Product Whisperer</em></p> <ul> <li>Proven ability to work with customers in a technical consulting, solutions engineering, or product engineering role</li> <li>Domain expertise in verticals like finance, healthcare, government, or manufacturing</li> <li>Experience with technical enablement or teaching programs</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Sample Projects</strong></h2> <p>The following are some examples of the types of projects we’ve worked on with customers. All of these projects leverage customer data, integrate directly into customers’ existing systems, and are deployed on their infrastructure.</p> <h3><strong>Deep Research for Due Diligence</strong></h3> <p>For a global professional services firm, we developed a sophisticated deep research agent to assist in due diligence. This agent employs a multi-agent architecture for robust fact-checking, integrates several internal MCP tools, and processes complex, unstructured data sources. This solution reliably saves employees hundreds of hours weekly.</p> <h3><strong>Churn Prediction</strong></h3> <p>Working with a TelCo organization, we built a model utilizing customer data to predict churn likelihood. The system then curates personalized offers based on this prediction. This model was integrated into a "next best action" copilot, enabling call center agents to proactively surface relevant offers to customers, leading to a significant reduction in churn.</p> <h3><strong>Data Extraction Voice Agent</strong></h3> <p>We partnered with a healthcare organization to create a lifelike voice agent and avatar designed to gather unstructured health information from patients. Engineered for low latency, the agent adeptly manages conversational flow, adheres to safety guardrails, and efficiently handles data extraction. This automation saves the organization's nurses hundreds of hours each week.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><em>PLEASE NOTE: </em></strong><em>Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.</em></p> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p><em>At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, </em><em>Ernst</em><em> </em><em>&</em><em> Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.</em></p> <p><em>We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status. </em></p> <p><em>We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at ----- Please see the United States Department of Labor's </em><a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf"><em>Know Your Rights poster</em></a><em> for additional information.</em></p> <p><em>We comply with the United States Department of Labor's </em><em>Pay Transparency provision</em><em>. </em></p> <p><em><strong>PLEASE NOTE: </strong>We collect, retain and use personal data for our professional business purposes, including notifying you of job opportunities that may be of interest and sharing with our affiliates. We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. Any information we collect in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our internal policies and programs designed to protect personal data. Please see our <a href="https://scale.com/legal/privacy" target="_blank">privacy policy</a> for additional information.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Executive Assistant, Data Center Operations EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <p>CoreWeave is building the next-generation public cloud for accelerated workloads, and our team is growing rapidly. As part of the Administrative & Operations function, you will support executives who are driving high-impact, cross-company initiatives. We value adaptability, ownership, and a sense of humor as we move fast and scale quickly.</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>In this role, you will provide support for 2-3 senior executives, ensuring they can operate efficiently and stay focused on top priorities. You will manage complex scheduling across multiple time zones, coordinate travel and expenses, and support key team activities including meetings, offsites, and reporting. You’ll play a central role in keeping the leadership team organized, informed, and moving forward by anticipating needs, driving follow-ups, and handling sensitive information with discretion. This position requires someone who is proactive, detail-oriented, and able to execute with minimal oversight.</p> <h3><strong>Basic Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience providing executive support to VP-level or above<br><br></li> <li>Proven project management experience<br><br></li> <li>Proficiency with Google Suite, Google Calendar, Slack, and Microsoft Office<br><br></li> <li>Experience coordinating travel logistics and processing expense reports<br><br></li> <li>Experience with event planning and meeting coordination<br><br></li> <li>Demonstrated ability to improve or streamline processes<br><br></li> <li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines across time zones<br><br></li> <li>Strong written communication skills, including drafting and editing documents<br><br></li> <li>Ability to independently execute tasks with high accuracy and attention to detail<br><br></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience supporting multiple executives simultaneously<br><br></li> <li>Experience working in a high-growth or rapidly scaling environment<br><br></li> <li>Familiarity with cross-functional coordination and leadership support<br><br></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit?</strong></h3> <p>We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring diverse experiences — even if you aren’t a perfect match on every skill. If some of this sounds like you, we’d love to talk:</p> <ul> <li>You love creating order out of complexity and helping leaders operate at their best<br><br></li> <li>You’re curious about how teams work and constantly look for ways to improve processes<br><br></li> <li>You’re an expert in staying organized and keeping cross-functional work on track<br><br></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h3> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong><strong><br><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong><strong><br><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong><strong><br><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong><strong><br><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong><strong><br><br></strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p><em>The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility). </em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Controller to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Controller’s behalf. title: Senior Solutions Architect
description: <h2>Alloy is where you belong!</h2> <p>Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.<br><br>Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of <a href="https://www.inc.com/profile/alloy_ny" target="_blank">Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces</a>, <a href="https://www.forbes.com/companies/alloy/?list=americas-best-startup-employers&sh=55c076453c61" target="_blank">Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers</a>, <a href="https://www.americanbanker.com/list/best-places-to-work-in-fintech-2022" target="_blank">Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker</a>, year after year.<br><br>Check out our investors and read more about us <a href="https://www.alloy.com/about" target="_blank">here</a>.</p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Solutions Architects play a major role in Alloy’s Technical Solutions organization and are paramount to deal success. The Solutions Architect is responsible for delivering the technical win for client accounts. You will handle the technical post-sales relationship, present product fit, propose technical architectures, demonstrate the product, anticipate concerns, and offer creative technical solutions to Alloy clients.</p> <p>Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our employees onsite three days a week.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Solutions Architect, you'll:</p> <ul> <li>Act as the technical lead on multiple client implementations and larger client project engagements, working closely with Alloy Implementations Managers</li> <li>Conduct technical and architectural overviews of client needs to propose Alloy product solutions to deliver on the client’s business goals</li> <li>Act as an expert advisor on the data vendors Alloy integrates with</li> <li>Help to integrate Alloy's API into an app in code</li> <li>Independently run end to end testing to ensure a successful client go live</li> <li>Be a part of a client production readiness and support production launches (these occasionally occur outside of 9a-5p hours)</li> <li>Serve as a client advocate by advocating for the evolution of Alloy’s products and services and driving client adoption of new capabilities </li> <li>Support the development of technical documentation and FAQs to serve client needs</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who we’re looking for</strong></h2> <p>You are both highly technical and a skilled relationship builder. You are comfortable in front of a variety of audiences, from explaining Alloy’s best practices to a bank’s compliance team to mapping an API flow on a whiteboard with a Fintech product and Engineering team. Alloy’s post-sales process is highly consultative and requires our team to be flexible, creative, and empathetic.</p> <ul> <li>4+ years experience implementing and supporting complex technical products with a strong desire to work in a post-sales, client-facing role</li> <li>Experience working in the fraud, KYC/KYB, Risk/Compliance and/or at a Fintech Startup</li> <li>Hands-on, passionate and creative problem solver</li> <li>Brings judgement to client discussions, focused on leading clients to successful outcomes aligned with their long term business goals</li> <li>Excellent communicator and presenter able to gain diverse audience confidence and buy-in</li> <li>Ability to build a deep understanding of a client's needs and guide them to a technical solution</li> <li>Proven success in problem-solving with and for enterprises with a variety of requirements and technical ability levels</li> <li>Experience working with REST APIs</li> <li>Previous software development experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred: <ul> <li>backend (Node.js, Python)</li> <li>web development (Javascript, HTML/CSS, frontend frameworks - React)</li> </ul> </li> <li>Able to travel occasionally (approximately once per quarter) for client on-sites.</li> </ul> <p>We're a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately, and opportunities will grow as the company scales up. If this all sounds like a good fit for you, why not join us?</p> <p>Alloy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Below is the anticipated starting base compensation range for this role; however, pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, in-demand skills, relevant experience, and/or geography. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!</p> <h2>Benefits and Perks </h2> <ul> <li>Unlimited holiday and flexible work policy</li> <li>Pension with employee contribution</li> <li>Up to 100% compensation for 16 weeks of parental leave</li> <li>Home office stipend for new employees</li> <li>Annual £900 learning & development stipend</li> <li>Equity plan</li> <li>Uncapped commissions</li> <li>Training programs to help foster growth (Alloy Foundations, Alloy Lead, Etc.)</li> <li>Private health and dental care</li> </ul> <h2>How to apply</h2> <p>Apply right here! We encourage applicants to share needed accommodations with their recruiter.</p> <p>All Alloy jobs are listed on our careers page. Any communication during the recruitment process, including interview requests or job offers, will come directly from a recruiting team member with an <a href="http://alloy.com/">alloy.com</a> email address. We do not use outside applications or automated text messaging in our recruiting process. We will not ask for any sensitive financial or identification information during the recruiting process. If you’re ever unsure, please contact us directly via our website before sharing personal information.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Group Overview: </span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Metrea Management </span></strong><span data-contrast="none">is our global shared service providing support for the Capabilities in areas such as People, Finance, Legal, Strategy, Safety, Security and Information Technology. </span> <br><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas—including airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special mission aviation, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. Whenever we operate, we build vertically integrated full stacks of capability—designing, building, and operating turnkey solutions that let customers scale capacity while benefiting from continuous cycles of innovation. With operators and engineers under one roof, we close the gap between lab and field—what we call connecting design with effect. Metrea’s solutions are built for elegance: effective, efficient, and evolving. This approach enables our partners to do more with less and achieve outsized, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats. Headquartered in Washington, DC, Metrea has facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, and beyond.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":288}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Position Summary </span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":288}"> </span></p> <p>At Metrea, we seek out the most complex national security challenges and proactively develop elegant solutions. title: Affiliate and Influencer Marketer
description: Granola is the AI notepad for people in back-to-back meetings. We're growing fast and looking for a hands-on affiliate / influencer / creator marketer to help us scale our partnership programmes across evergreen and launch campaigns. This is an individual contributor role. The opportunity We are looking for an affiliate and influencer marketer to join our team at Granola. We work with hundreds of creators and publishers to support acquiring new users through partnerships (sponsorships, affiliation and hybrid models). You'll sit at the intersection of branding and growth, making sure we’re proud of the online narratives around Granola and checking the performance of our influencer marketing efforts at a channel and partner level. What you’ll do Own a creator portfolio : Be responsible for growing and looking after a large portfolio of key accounts (sponsored, affiliates or hybrid) and regularly keeping in touch with them to increase Granola’s presence on their different channels Newsletter sponsorships : You'll own this channel end to end, from partner onboarding and booking through live-date tracking, invoicing, and performance reporting. Influencer partnerships : Sourcing and onboarding great creators for authentic collaborations. Instead of an ad placement, you’ll do demos of granola, find ideas and creative briefs for the influencers that would bring new user acquisitions too YouTube collaborations : Running campaigns with youtube creators to meet internal priorities through integrations, dedicated videos and editorial projects. Example projects you might work on Newsletter creatives : draft launch announcements and evergreen copy, and work with our design and copywriting team to get assets for our ads placements. Review editorial pieces for accuracy and brand safety. AEO portfolio. Increase the amount of citations on LLM through YouTube partnerships and listicle sponsorships, measuring the impact on citations from your work Account management : being the point of contact for a portfolio of affiliates / creators with large audiences, building win-win deals and generating authentic content. Your background looks something like… 3 years in influencer / affiliate marketing , brand-side or agency side. You’ve worked on significant creator collaborations that had tangible business impact (we’ll ask for example of campaigns you’ve run or a portfolio) A track record of managing a large portfolio of accounts and co-building the systems to support working with hundreds of vendors and deals at once, without sacrificing the quality of deliverables Experience working at a startup or scale up, preferably in tech, AI or B2B SaaS space. You understand the future of work and Granola’s ICP (enterprise and self-serve) As a person, you… Have high-agency and business acumen. You’re able to autonomously allocate budget, negotiate with creators, unstuck collaborations including at-risk accounts Are AI-native but know when to use it and when it is an overkill Are extremely good at prioritizing - picking what will really move the needles with goals and saying no to what is just busy work Have deep interest, curiosity and understanding around the creator economy and brand partnerships. You know that the playbooks get constantly re-written and you proactively keep up with the industry. Are chronically online and already know partners that would be a great fit for Granola. Bonus if you have existing relationships with creators, publishers and key opinion leaders that would be a great fit for Granola. Are creative and can select creators who have a tasteful editorial line and content style. You’d be able to scout the partners we’d be proud to collaborate with not only through data but also by instincts. Your experience helps you tell who can build trust and influence. About the opportunity This is the opportunity to come shape the narrative of Granola with creators while generating measurable growth, on the branding and user acquisition side, and create business impact at one of the fastest growing AI company in London. We work primarily together in London (office-first). You can find more about the team, how we work and our benefits on our careers page . If this sounds like work you’d love doing, we’d like to hear from you—even if your experience doesn’t match every point above. Compensation Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity. title: Sales Executive
description: About Zego 🚀 At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing. Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive. We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖 For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook. We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers. Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor . If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring. What you'll be doing You will work through the new and existing business leads by making outbound calls to prospective customers, helping them through the sales process. You'll deal with incoming sales calls, mid-term adjustments, renewals and returning customers. You will assess customers insurance needs and advice on appropriate Zego insurance products, whilst always following compliance guidelines. You will ensure customer satisfaction and provide professional customer support over phone, live chat and email. You will maintain a positive, empathetic and professional attitude towards customers at all times and build productive trust relationships. You will respond promptly to customer inquiries whilst making sure all communication is documented and logged in our internal system. You will follow GDPR guidelines and processes in all communication with customers What you will need to be successful You will have proven skills working within a high performing target-driven customer call centre- sales and service environment, ideally in a call centre setting. You've worked in a high target environment, high revenue, daily call targets. You are obsessive about customer experience and act as an advocate for our customer’s needs. You're able to listen to customers and be able to give advice and support. You have an ability to multitask, set priorities and manage time effectively. You will have a good understanding of GDPR rules and regulations and be able to use multiple systems at the same time. Ideally, you will have experience in insurance or an FCA regulated business. The Zego ways of working 🏡 Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it. We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year. Here is what the last one looked like . Benefits 🎁 💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year. 🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution. 📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build 🩺 Private medical insurance. 🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new. 💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact. Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you. Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance. Equal opportunities 🌈 We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. title: Developer Portal & Community Manager
description: We are the creators of Flipper Zero — a portable device for tech enthusiasts and engineers. It’s a gadget with an awesome community that brings together millions of people around the world. We’re building a new product — Flipper One . It’s a full-featured ARM-based computer running Linux in a compact form factor, powered by the Rockchip RK3576 SoC. We’ve decided to make the entire development process completely open and public. That’s why we’re looking for a Developer Portal & Community Manager to own and manage the entire Flipper One Developer Portal: maintaining the wiki, collecting tasks from all development teams, managing all GitHub projects and repositories, and proactively communicating with the community. This role is perfect for you if you want to be close to the product, see firsthand how it’s built, and help turn that process into a clear and valuable entry point for the community. This is not a “content manager” role — you’ll need to fully understand the development process, track all ongoing tasks, and connect the team with the community to make things happen. What is the Developer Portal? The Developer Portal is a public wiki + a set of GitHub projects built around Flipper One. It documents how the project works as a whole, explains the architecture of its major subsystems, and provides contribution guides for the community — showing how people can contribute to each sub-project. Anyone reading the Developer Portal wiki should come away with a complete understanding of the project structure, each feature, and what exactly we are building. Requirements: You write clearly, concisely, and without fluff, and can show examples of your work: guides, instructions, READMEs, how-tos, or similar materials Basic understanding of hardware, software, and development workflows (Git, commits, branches, pull requests) Able to explain complex technical topics in simple language and visualize them with flowchart sketches Strong verbal communication skills; you know how to listen, ask precise questions, and quickly extract the key points from chaotic discussions Keep communication with the community productive — without toxicity, unnecessary softness, or bureaucracy Comfortable collaborating closely with engineers and navigating technical contexts Discern useful feedback and constructive disagreement from noise and spam Value structure, logic, clarity, and information quality Genuinely interested in developer-facing products, hardware, documentation, open communities, and the build-in-public approach Proficiency in Russian and English for communication with other departments in the company and the external community Nice-to-have: Experience in DevRel, technical writing, community operations, or an editorial role Experience working with documentation, wikis, knowledge bases, or developer portals Understanding of the culture of technical communities, open-source, and hardware projects Ability to work across topics at the intersection of interfaces, electronics, product architecture, and internal development Responsibilites: Own and develop the Flipper One Developer Portal Turn the team’s internal context into clear public documentation, notes, updates, and explanations Join team calls to understand what’s actually happening in the project and maintain a complete picture of it Translate technical discussions into clear, human language without losing meaning or accuracy Moderate community comments, pull requests, and contributions Filter out spam, reduce noise, and keep discussions productive Help users understand how the portal works and how to provide useful feedback Collect signals from the community and bring them back to the team Make sure the portal stays structured, up to date, and genuinely useful What we offer: Fully remote from anywhere in the world You will be provided with all the necessary equipment for a comfortable working environment Benefits such as VHI, corporate title: Quality Manager- Manufacturing Operations
description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. About the role Based in the UK you will be a key member of the Manufacturing Operations team where you will drive the development of our business management systems as well as our product, supplier, software and customer quality initiatives. You will be comfortable with assessing processes and technologies to identify quality gaps and provide robust but pragmatic solutions to drive all aspects of the business in achieving the highest levels of quality and resilience. Key responsibilities Define and deliver the company quality strategy, policy and objectives, aligned to the product roadmap and growth plan. Build, lead and develop a quality team covering supplier, product, reliability, software and systems quality. Define and report quality performance to the executive team. Establish appropriate document control, change control, CAPA, internal audit, training and records processes that scale with a fast-growing fabless company. Work with PMO to embed quality gates into the new product introduction (NPI) and product lifecycle process, from concept through end of life. Own quality across the supply chain: wafer foundry, assembly and packaging, wafer and final test, PCB/PCBA and system-level contract manufacturers. Lead supplier selection, qualification, audits and ongoing performance management, including scorecards and quarterly business reviews. Work with engineering leaders to define software quality standards across drivers, firmware, compilers, SDKs and runtime. Establish release criteria, test coverage expectations, defect management and regression processes, aligned with CI/CD practice. Bring in secure development and software supply chain practice, including SBOMs and vulnerability management. Support responsible AI and AI management practice where customers ask for it, including awareness of ISO/IEC 42001. Be the senior point of contact for customer quality, audits and escalations. Lead customer RMA and complaint handling, root cause analysis and 8D responses to agreed timelines. Ensure product compliance with RoHS, REACH, WEEE, conflict minerals reporting, UKCA and CE marking, and relevant safety and EMC standards. Essential experience and skills Significant experience in quality roles in semiconductors or electronics hardware, including creating and leading a quality function or team. Direct experience managing quality through outsourced manufacturing: foundries, OSATs, test houses and/or contract manufacturers. Deep knowledge of ISO 9001 and hands-on experience building or running a certified QMS. Working knowledge of semiconductor qualification and reliability (JEDEC), failure analysis and Awareness of data centre RAS assessments and HPC system qualification and certification. Fluency in core quality tools: 8D, FMEA, control plans, SPC, MSA and root cause analysis. Experience handling customer quality escalations with large, demanding customers. Degree in electrical or electronic engineering, materials science, physics or a related discipline. Clear, confident communicator who can influence engineers, suppliers and executives, and hold partners to account. Willing to travel internationally, including to Asia and US, for supplier audits and customer quality reviews. Desirable Experience in a fabless company, particularly one bringing an initial product to volume. Background in high-performance compute, data centre, networking or AI hardware. Exposure to software quality, release management or secure development practice. Lead auditor certification (ISO 9001), Six Sigma Black Belt, or chartered status (for example CQI or IET). Experience working with suppliers in Taiwan, South Korea or US. The impact you will have You will help Fractile to makes sure every one of our suppliers builds to our standard, and that our customers receive AI hardware and software they can trust in production whilst shaping the quality culture across engineering, operations and commercial teams.
