title: Applied ML Technical Lead, Defence
description: Job title: Applied ML Technical Lead, Defence Location: London; full in-office working as default Start date: ASAP Reports to: CEO Compensation: Salary and Equity options available for discussion Clearance: Must be eligible to hold UK Security Vetting Clearance SC or above (no prior clearance required) Application Deadline: 08/11/26 at 23:59 UK Time ___________________________________________________________________________ Help put frontier AI to work in Defence Cosine is a UK AI lab building models, applications and training infrastructure for mission-critical organisations. We build coding agents that work across real software systems, specialised Lumen models, AI-native security products and the infrastructure needed to deploy advanced AI in demanding environments. Our customers include some of the world's largest enterprises, including organisations operating behind strict security, regulatory and technical constraints. We're also training Lumen Sovereign, the first frontier large language model trained in the UK, with the support of the UK Government. We're now looking for an Applied ML Technical Lead to help develop and deploy advanced AI capabilities for organisations operating in UK Defence and national security. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will work across machine learning development, deployment and customer-facing technical delivery. You may spend part of your time training and evaluating models on complex sensor data, and part of your time working with Defence stakeholders to understand operational needs, shape priorities and guide delivery. You will not be expected to act as a traditional project manager. Instead, you will own the technical direction and day-to-day progress of applied ML work, coordinating the people and decisions needed to turn promising research into useful operational capability. ___________________________________________________________________________ What you'll do Build ML capabilities for real Defence problems Design, build, train and evaluate machine learning models for challenging applied Defence and national security use cases. Work on problems involving complex sensor data, signal processing, pattern recognition, classification and multimodal intelligence. Develop and improve model architectures, training pipelines, evaluation frameworks and inference systems. Work with real-world and synthetic datasets to improve model accuracy, robustness and generalisation. Translate research prototypes into reliable, deployable capabilities that operate within demanding technical and security constraints. Work closely with Cosine's ML research and engineering teams while taking direct ownership of technical outcomes. Lead technical delivery from prototype to deployment Own the technical direction and day-to-day progress of applied ML projects. Turn operational objectives into concrete technical goals, experiments, milestones and success measures. Coordinate work across ML researchers, software engineers, infrastructure teams and external stakeholders. Identify technical dependencies, delivery risks and blockers, and help drive them to resolution. Establish clear evaluation criteria and demonstrate progress through measurable improvements and working capabilities. Balance hands-on engineering with the planning and coordination needed to keep complex technical work moving. Work directly with Defence customers Engage with technical and operational stakeholders across the UK Defence and national security ecosystem. Understand operational challenges and identify where machine learning can make a meaningful difference. Translate customer requirements and constraints into technical objectives, datasets, experiments and delivery plans. Present technical progress, demonstrate working capabilities and communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Build trusted relationships with Defence stakeholders and act as a credible technical counterpart. Help customers understand the practical considerations of integrating and deploying ML systems in their existing environments. Turn research into operational capability Help deploy ML models into real-world environments, including secure, on-premise and resource-constrained systems. Work on model optimisation, inference performance, integration and reliability. Develop robust approaches to evaluation, validation and continuous model improvement. Understand data availability, access requirements, security restrictions and deployment constraints. Establish feedback loops between operational users and Cosine's engineering teams. Ensure that what we build is not only technically impressive, but genuinely useful to the people relying on it. ___________________________________________________________________________ What we’re looking for You'll probably have a background in applied machine learning, ML engineering, research engineering or a similarly technical role, along with experience taking ownership of complex technical work. You should be comfortable: Writing production-quality Python and working with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch. Building, training, fine-tuning and evaluating machine learning models. Working with complex datasets, designing experiments and interpreting model performance. Understanding the trade-offs between model performance, compute requirements, latency and deployment constraints. Working with engineering infrastructure, including Git, containers, Linux and GPU compute. Taking technical ownership of projects with multiple stakeholders, uncertain requirements and evolving priorities. Communicating technical concepts clearly to researchers, engineers, senior stakeholders and operational users. Moving between model development, customer discussions and delivery planning without losing technical depth. Making sound technical judgements, prioritising effectively and finding practical solutions when the path forward is unclear. You don't need to have worked in Defence before. You do need to be excited by the opportunity to apply advanced ML to difficult, consequential real-world problems. Nice to have Existing UK security clearance, such as SC or DV, or previous experience working in secure Defence environments. Experience with signal processing, time-series data, sensor fusion, representation learning or machine learning applied to complex real-world datasets. Experience with foundation models, multimodal learning or advanced model training and post-training techniques. Experience deploying ML models to edge devices or constrained compute environments. Familiarity with UK Defence procurement, technical assurance or the national security landscape. Experience leading technical workstreams or working as a technical lead on customer-facing ML projects. ___________________________________________________________________________ What success looks like In your first three months, we would expect you to: Become the technical lead for a major applied Defence ML programme, with responsibility for its day-to-day technical progress. Build strong working relationships with Cosine's ML researchers, engineers and key Defence customer stakeholders. Develop a clear understanding of the existing models, datasets, technical architecture and operational objectives. Establish a focused delivery plan with clear priorities, milestones, ownership and success measures. Make meaningful hands-on contributions to model development, evaluation or deployment. Identify and begin addressing the most important technical and operational blockers. Demonstrate tangible progress to customer stakeholders and build confidence in Cosine's ability to deliver. Longer term, you'll help take advanced ML capabilities from promising prototypes into operational use, while shaping how Cosine builds and delivers applied AI for Defence and other mission-critical organisations. ___________________________________________________________________________ Why this role matters Some of the most important applications of AI won't be found in consumer products. They'll be in environments where information is incomplete, systems are complex, security matters and the consequences of getting things wrong are significant. Cosine is working to bring frontier machine learning into those environments. Doing that requires more than good models. It requires people who can understand an operational problem, build something that works, make good technical decisions, coordinate the work needed to deliver it and stay close to the customer until it creates real value. You'll have unusual proximity to cutting-edge ML research, senior Defence stakeholders and the operational challenges that will shape the next generation of AI capabilities. This role will suit someone who is technically strong enough to build, organised enough to lead technical delivery and curious enough to engage directly with the people using the technology. If you enjoy being close to the research, close to customers and personally accountable for turning ambitious technology into something real, come and work with us. Come help make frontier AI useful where it matters most. ___________________________________________________________________________ Cosine is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and ways of thinking, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful workplace. We encourage applications from anyone who meets the role requirements, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. Continuous Delivery. We deploy small, incremental changes to production multiple times per day, enabling rapid iteration and fast customer feedback loops. Collaboration and Autonomy. We regularly engage directly with customers to understand their problems, gather feedback, and ensure we're building products that create genuine value. About You You're deep in React. title: Senior International Sales Recruiter, UK/EMEA
description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. "At TRM, we believe the people we hire will determine how far and how fast we can go in our mission to build a safer world for billions of people. That’s why we’re building a Talent team that sees recruiting as a craft and a competitive advantage, people who challenge assumptions, move with urgency, and are energized by building exceptional teams to solve incredibly hard problems. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you." – Alicia Strait , VP of Talent, TRM Labs As TRM expands across EMEA and other global markets, our ability to hire the right sellers, compliance experts, and go-to-market talent in-region determines how fast our blockchain intelligence reaches the institutions and agencies fighting illicit finance worldwide. As an International Sales Recruiter , you'll own high-priority searches across EMEA and beyond — Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and broader business roles — partnering closely with hiring managers and Talent leadership to define strategy, map regional markets, engage passive candidates, and drive high-quality hiring decisions with speed and precision. Your success is measured by the quality, velocity, and business impact of the hires you make across TRM's international business functions. The impact you'll have: Own full-cycle recruiting for international roles across Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and other functions. Act as a strategic talent partner to hiring managers, including advising on market dynamics, candidate calibration, sourcing strategy, and close approach. Build and execute targeted sourcing strategies that identify, engage, and close exceptional talent across EMEA and other global markets. Develop regional talent maps across priority markets that include high-performing companies, competitive talent, referral networks, and specialized candidate communities. Create an exceptional candidate experience where every touchpoint reflects TRM's talent bar, mission, and operating principles. Use data, market insight, and funnel conversion metrics to diagnose search health, influence hiring teams, and adjust strategy in real time. Drive urgency and decision quality through clear calibration, structured feedback, and timely hiring decisions. Continuously improve international recruiting including intake quality, scorecard alignment, sourcing strategy, debrief rigor, and offer execution. Partner cross-functionally with Talent, People, Finance, Legal, and business leaders to navigate international hiring considerations and keep searches moving. What we're looking for: 7+ years of recruiting experience, with strong experience supporting international sales hiring in high-growth technology companies. Proven success hiring across Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and other business functions. Strong knowledge of EMEA talent markets, with the ability to adapt strategy by region, function, and candidate profile. Strong search fundamentals including market mapping, talent intelligence, passive candidate engagement, candidate assessment, and closing. The ability to quickly understand complex business roles across GTM, compliance, marketing, and operations. Strong analytical ability to interpret recruiting metrics, funnel health, conversion rates, and pipeline quality and translate them into action. Exceptional stakeholder management that includes building trust, influencing hiring managers, pushing back thoughtfully, and operating as a strategic advisor. Excellent written and verbal communication, including synthesizing market insight, candidate tradeoffs, and search progress clearly for stakeholders. High ownership, autonomy, persistence, and judgment in navigating ambiguous, specialized, business-critical searches. The ability to operate effectively in a remote, globally distributed environment with strong overlap across EMEA and U.S. business hours. About the team: Our talent team is fully remote and async-first. We keep work moving across time zones through Slack, thorough documentation, and proactive updates. We stay tightly aligned through weekly hiring syncs, team sourcing syncs, and bi-weekly team meetings where we solve challenges together. We care deeply about our craft: we continuously refine best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for candidates and internal stakeholders alike, backed by precise, reliable reporting. We're globally distributed but most of us overlap between 7am–12pm PST for real-time collaboration. Every team member, wherever they're based, maintains at least a 4-hour overlap with PST business hours. Learn about TRM Speed in this position: Within 72 hours of a role opening, you've scheduled the intake, researched and published the role, and brought 5 calibration profiles to the intake for the hiring manager to review. Within a week of opening the role, you've mapped the total addressable market, built a shortlist of the top 30 profiles, conducted 5–10 recruiter screens, and stood up the full interview process — including the approved questions that define what good looks like on a recruiter screen. Two weeks after the initial interviews, you analyze the data to identify what is and isn't driving pass rates and conversions, share insights and recommendations with the hiring team, and continue to monitor and adjust until the position is filled. Our Onboarding Process: Within your first 30 days , you’ll be fully onboarded, calibrated, and operating as the DRI for your positions. Within your first 60 days , you’ll have your first sourced candidates reaching final rounds. Within your first 90 days , you’ll have made 2–3 hires . The following represents the estimated range of compensation for this role: Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only The estimated base salary range for this role is $153,000 - $172,000. Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan. Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States. Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered. Interviewing with TRM Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview. Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role. Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact. First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role. Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM. References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact. Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details. Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you! Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way. AI Fluency at TRM AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM. We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks. At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to: Accelerate repeatable workflows Structure and solve problems Improve output quality Increase speed and leverage You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process. Life at TRM We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day. TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving. At TRM, you should expect: Priorities and targets to change quickly Operating with a high degree of ambiguity A high level of personal ownership and accountability Close collaboration across teams and functions Frequent, high-touch communication Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment. We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Leadership Principles We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday. Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger. Join our Mission At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast. TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. title: Senior Data Engineer
description: About Us At XYZ Reality, we are an award-winning Series B business scaling across the UK, US and Europe. Our mission is to expand our platform, enhancing features, performance, and scalability while revolutionizing the construction industry. We are a multi-disciplinary, fast-paced company working across diverse domains, including cloud development, data governance and processing pipelines, electronics, embedded software/hardware, mechanical design/manufacturing, AI & computer vision, and data science, all powering our BIM Platform. title: Product Designer
description: <p><strong>About CreativeX</strong></p> <p>CreativeX is B2B SaaS technology platform that helps global marketing teams make smarter creative decisions and elevate creative expression through the clarity of data. Our technology powers creative decision-making at some of the biggest brands in the world, including Google, Unilever, Pepsi, Bayer, Mondelez, Heineken, and more.</p> <p>We use computer vision and other machine learning techniques to extract creative data from our client's digital advertising copy and transform those previously dark signals into a standardised data model at industrial scale. This creates a new, unique and powerful first party data set that represents the last and most impactful untapped reservoir of advertising performance.</p> <p>That's because multiple studies have shown that the "Creative" itself is responsible for half of sales lift online, higher than reach, targeting, brand, & recency combined. But creative impact has always been the least analysed and least understood component of a complex set of marketing variables.</p> <p>This is the problem CreativeX is focussed on solving. We're an end-to-end solution to ingest, process, and analyse content at scale. We help brands isolate creative elements so they can be analysed against downstream ad impact metrics, from clickthrough rates to brand lift.</p> <p>Our objective is to help marketing organisations power every creative decision with data.</p> <p><strong>Product Design Team</strong></p> <p>As a Product Designer, you'll help shape the next generation of the CreativeX platform, taking problems from discovery through to shipped experiences across defined areas of the product. You'll be the design lead in a product trio alongside a Product Manager and an Engineering Lead, owning whether users want what we build and whether they can figure out how to use it, while sharing discovery, outcomes and trade-offs with your partners. CreativeX is a complex product with rich data, multiple user types and increasingly sophisticated AI capabilities, and as AI increases the volume and speed of creative production, you'll make that complexity work for marketers, helping them measure performance fast, find the patterns behind what's working and see whether their full set of ads is delivering the strategy. Our roadmap is framed as problems to solve, not screens to make, so we expect you to bring a point of view. Product Design is a small, hands-on team in a scale-up: you'll be trusted with real ownership early, and this hire is an important step in growing the team.</p> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own design for defined product areas, from understanding the problem through to working with Product and Engineering to ship the right experience</li> <li>Get close to marketers and creative teams through customer conversations, research and usability testing, using what you learn to inform design decisions</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering in discovery to validate real problems, challenge assumptions and make sensible trade-offs between customer value, business needs and technical constraints</li> <li>Turn creative data, insights and AI-powered capabilities into intuitive workflows, dashboards and decision-making tools</li> <li>Design for the platform, not just the feature, building on existing patterns and connecting experiences across CreativeX</li> <li>Use and extend our design system, creating and documenting patterns and components so they're implemented consistently</li> <li>Raise the quality bar through strong interaction and visual design craft, and by giving and receiving feedback in critiques</li> <li>Learn from what you ship, using customer feedback, product data and research to improve the experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>What success looks like</strong></p> <p><em>In your first 90 days</em></p> <ul> <li>Learn the CreativeX platform, our customers and our design system, and work as the design lead in your product trio</li> <li>Take ownership of a defined product area and ship, or get build-ready, your first piece of work</li> <li>Contribute to our AI-powered product work and add to or improve patterns in our design system</li> <li>Join customer conversations and use what you hear to shape your design decisions</li> </ul> <p><em>In your first year</em></p> <ul> <li>Own design for one or more product areas, taking work from discovery through to launch with little direction</li> <li>Ship work you can point to, using customer feedback and product data to show whether it solved the problem</li> <li>Help build out new parts of our design system and make the product feel more coherent across areas</li> <li>Shape how design works at CreativeX as the team grows, including supporting newer designers</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are</strong></p> <ul> <li>3–5 years of product design experience, with a portfolio that shows how you framed problems, explored options, made trade-offs and learned from what shipped</li> <li>Strong interaction and visual design craft, confident in Figma, prototyping and design systems, and familiar with Slack and Linear</li> <li>Experience using research, usability testing and customer feedback to inform design decisions</li> <li>A systems mindset and the ability to make complex information, workflows and data easy to understand</li> <li>Clear, collaborative communication: you challenge ideas constructively, take feedback well and know when to ship and learn</li> <li>Experience working closely with Product and Engineering in a product trio or small team, with real ownership</li> <li><em>Nice to have:</em> B2B SaaS, data-heavy or analytics products; marketing, advertising or martech; AI-powered products; mentoring junior designers; scale-up experience</li> </ul> <p>At CreativeX, we encourage applicants of all backgrounds and identities to apply for roles that align with their own interests and career trajectory. If you fit the description above and see yourself in this role, we would love to see your application! <em>Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship at this time.</em></p> <p><strong>What we offer</strong></p> <p>🍎 Private Medical Insurance and Health Cash Plan<br>✈️ Generous time off + bank holidays<br>📚 Education budget to be used for individual learning experiences or grouped with your team for joint learning<br>🧘 Annual subscription to Calm and Headspace for your mental wellbeing<br>🎟 Monthly coaching to talk to a trained professional about career goals, relationships, and personal development<br>💵 Competitive salary including stock options, as we believe that everyone should have a stake in the business<br>🍼 4-month full pay parenting leave for all employees who have been with the company for one (1) year</p> <p><em><strong>CreativeX provides equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees.</strong></em></p> <p><em>As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure workplace, CreativeX conducts standard right to work and background checks on all potential employees. This process is designed to verify the accuracy of information provided by candidates and to ensure a safe environment for all employees. Background checks are conducted via a secure third party application and in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.</em></p> <p></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <h3><strong>WHO WE ARE </strong></h3> <p>Headquartered in New York City, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. Your work will empower the organization with accurate, actionable insights into technology assets within a fast-paced, creative environment.</p> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL TAKE ON</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Configure & Customize:</strong> Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of ServiceNow Discovery and Service Mapping, including MID servers, network/security settings, probes, patterns, and schedules.</li> <li><strong>Integrate & Automate:</strong> Build and maintain integrations via IntegrationHub, Service Graph Connectors, and scripted REST/SOAP APIs.</li> <li><strong>AI Innovation:</strong> Identify and implement high-impact opportunities for embedding GenAI and Agentic Workflows into IT Operations for alert analysis, remediation, and data anomaly detection.</li> <li><strong>Governance & Health:</strong> Oversee CMDB health maintenance, data normalization, and reconciliation processes to ensure a "self-healing" IT environment.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate:</strong> Act as a bridge between technical infrastructure and business stakeholders to translate complex operational challenges into scalable, AI-driven solutions.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU BRING</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p><strong>ServiceNow Expertise:</strong> Deep technical proficiency in the ServiceNow platform, including base system data structures and ITOM Visibility solutions.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Technical Skillset: </strong>Advanced JavaScript, GlideRecord, GlideAjax, PowerShell, Business Rules, and Flow Designer.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Discovery:</strong> Expert-level knowledge of Discovery patterns, credentials, and error handling.</li> <li><strong>Frameworks:</strong> Strong understanding of ITSM, ITAM, VR, and ITIL (specifically CI and asset lifecycle management).</li> </ul> </li> <li> <p><strong>Infrastructure Knowledge:</strong> Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), virtualization (hypervisors, containerization), and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Data Mastery:</strong> Proven experience in data analysis, reporting, and complex data quality governance.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Soft Skills:</strong> Exceptional interpersonal and leadership skills with a track record of driving consensus across diverse teams.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Emerging Tech:</strong> Demonstrated experience integrating AI/ML-assisted features and Agentic Workflows to enhance team productivity.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT WE OFFER YOU</strong></h3> <p><strong></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Great Company Culture</strong>. We pride ourselves as being one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success.</li> <li><strong>Growth</strong>: As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company.</li> <li><strong>Work Hard, Play Hard.</strong> Our employees’ bond, blow-off steam, and flex some creative muscles – through corporate boot camp classes, our onsite Gym, company parties, our Office bar, game release events, monthly socials, and team challenges.</li> <li><strong>Benefits</strong>. title: 3D Reconstruction Research Scientist/Engineer
description: About Niantic Spatial AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. About the Role You’ll join our Research Team in London as a 3D Reconstruction Research Scientist/Engineer — working at both ends of the pipeline, from cutting-edge academic research to shipping directly to customers. Our team builds the reconstruction technology that turns casually captured or domain-specific imagery into high-fidelity 3D reconstructions: everything from Structure-from-Motion through 3D Gaussian Splatting, feed-forward models, and generative models. We’ve shipped 360 splatting to consumers and enterprise customers, developed the splatting tech that runs on phones, and published at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, and SIGGRAPH — more often than not, our papers end up in production. You’ll work alongside world-class researchers in computer vision, machine learning, graphics, and robotics on large-scale spatial understanding, localization, reconstruction, scene understanding, and geospatial foundation models. What You’ll Do Research & Publication — Conduct original research in 3D computer vision, machine learning, and spatial AI; publish findings at top-tier venues including CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, and SIGGRAPH. Algorithm Development — Design, implement, and evaluate novel algorithms across 3D reconstruction, neural scene representations, 3D Gaussian Splatting, SfM, meshing, geometric deep learning, feed-forward models, generative models, and spatial foundation models. Research-to-Production — Collaborate with research scientists and engineers to transition promising ideas into customer-facing products — working directly with real capture conditions, real hardware constraints, and real customers on short turnarounds. Large-Scale Experimentation — Build and run large-scale experiments and benchmarking frameworks to rigorously validate and advance new methods. Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration — Partner with world-class researchers in CV, ML, graphics, and robotics to advance large-scale spatial understanding, localization, reconstruction, and geospatial foundation models. Rapid Prototyping — Implement and iterate on state-of-the-art methods for both academic publishing and production deployment, delivering working prototypes to enterprise customers with speed and quality. What You’ll Bring PhD in Computer Vision, Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a closely related field — or equivalent demonstrated research experience in industry. A strong research track record in 3D computer vision: reconstruction, depth estimation, novel view synthesis, SfM, SLAM, or closely related areas. A meaningful publication record at top-tier venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, SIGGRAPH, NeurIPS, or equivalent). Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch. Evidence that you can carry an idea from research into something real — a shipped feature, a production pipeline, a widely used open-source release, or similar. The independence to drive research projects from idea generation through experimentation, publication, and handoff. Nice to Have Experience with classical reconstruction tooling (COLMAP or similar). C++ or CUDA experience, and a feel for performance and on-device constraints. Experience with traditional 3D techniques — meshing, texturing, or bringing modern geometry or generative representations into native 3D. Compensation & Benefits Base salary: Competitive market rate. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Location & Work Model This role is based in our London office, with three days per week in office. title: Senior Social Strategist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Ogilvy  </strong></p> <p>Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named <a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-brings-home-network-year-2026-cannes-lions-international-festival-creativity">Network of the Year</a> at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-tops-warc-effective-100-creative-100-4th-straight-year" data-outlook-id="e2c78315-ff05-4544-925f-9288319dea2c">ranks</a><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>For more information, visit <a href="http://www.ogilvy.com/" target="_blank" data-outlook-id="39833259-880d-4fd8-930f-0d84b1c14850">Ogilvy.com</a>, and follow us on<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="735e393e-6e8a-4ca8-804a-74f1bd8166b6">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ogilvy" data-outlook-id="d10960ce-761b-48c5-81d5-0a7c4cc6013a">X</a>,<a href="https://www.instagram.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="92ffcb70-6ca7-4d9a-88d5-c130e36e6c4f"> Instagram</a>, and<a href="https://www.facebook.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="3bd2010d-00a2-401b-8cfb-7e8c24deac52"> Facebook.</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="7f087527-f491-4cb6-a79d-3b4a67d1ec89">WPP.com</a></u>.</p> <p> </p></div><p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Senior Social Strategist</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Department:</strong> Social Strategy</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> London</p> <p><strong>Contract type:</strong> 12-month Fixed Term Contract</p> <p><strong>Full Time/Part time:</strong> Full time</p> <p><strong>Reporting into:</strong> Head of Social Strategy</p> <p><br><br></p> <p><strong>The Role:</strong> </p> <p>This is an exciting opportunity at Ogilvy to play a key role in elevating our social capabilities for 2026 and beyond, helping us redefine our social and content offer and realize our new global ambition of ‘building social brands’. Ogilvy is seeking an experienced <strong>Senior Strategist</strong> who will sit within our Social Strategy team. They will be responsible for collaborating closely with clients to gain a deep understanding of their businesses, target audiences, and brand values and developing bold creative strategies that answer their unique challenges. You’ll take full ownership of key workstreams and use your deep social knowledge to develop innovation strategic solutions. You’ll also benefit from being part of Ogilvy’s wider strategy community where you’ll work alongside - and learn from - specialised strategists in PR, influence, brand and experience, as well as experts in behavioural science and consulting.</p> <p>As a mentor and a leader, you’ll help guide and support junior team members in their professional growth and strategic development, because you know what great social strategy looks like. You’ll advocate for diversity of thought and champion inclusive approaches from the team, because you know that strategy can come in lots of different flavours and a great insight can be found anywhere.  </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic development and execution:</strong> Lead the development of social and content strategies, playbooks, workshops, and measurement frameworks for clients (with guidance from the team lead on bigger projects). Adapt the strategic output based on client need (e.g. tissue decks, strategic responses, paths forward, workshops, etc). Define the brands’ role of social and create messaging frameworks with clear content pillars, all laddering back to the overall brand vision and supported by social intelligence data. Build trust and rapport with clients and colleagues and sell them on your strong strategic thinking.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Creative briefing: </strong>Develop strategic creative territories and write clear briefs for the creative team to explore them. Articulate social-first creative ideas to clients and help them understand how/ why they work.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Insight mining and creative problem solving:</strong>. Intuitively understand client challenges and leverage business data to get to the core of the problem. Uncover unexpected insights from a diverse range of sources to help shape your social communication strategies. Interpret reporting data to suggest improvements to campaign or organic social performance.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Impactful storyteller and engaging presenter: </strong>Inspire internal and external stakeholders on the strategic opportunities of social and present narratives in compelling and memorable ways. Design and lead workshops/ client presentations and act as an ideas catalyst and strategic partner for clients, asking insightful questions to get clients thinking differently about their brand on social.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Leading and mentoring junior team members:</strong>. Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members, fostering their growth and leading by example. Contribute to Ogilvy's culture of excellence, innovation, and impactful creativity. Know what a great social strategy looks like and help upskill team members on that thinking.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Thinking social first, not social only: </strong>Possess a deep understanding of social best practises, trends, tools and technologies and apply this knowledge to clients to enhance their campaign performance. Share industry insights and best practices to inspire internal teams and clients. Understand and articulate how social works within the larger media ecosystem and within the client’s broader campaign/ business goals.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Collaborating cross functionally:</strong> Think laterally about how to uncover unique insights by working closely with our in-house Marketing Science partners to test hypotheses and get to the right answers. Ensure alignment of campaigns with brand strategies by collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. Contribute to new business pitches and proposals, infusing industry insights and creative ideas.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Experience designing tailored strategic social plans that address diverse business goals, incorporating latest social trends and best practises.</li> <li>Relentlessly curious about social, with a deep knowledge of social trends, platforms and aesthetics. A proactive approach to staying updated with industry trends, tools, and technologies.</li> <li>Experience defining the role of social for brands and creating messaging frameworks for brands with clear content territories/ pillars.</li> <li>Experience in creative agencies or equivalent environments. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple projects and priorities efficiently.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members. Commitment to fostering inclusivity and embracing innovative approaches to strategy development.</li> <li>Effective presentation skills to convey ideas and strategies convincingly. Ability to lead presentations/ workshops confidently.</li> <li>Ability to collaborate effectively with XFN teams and with colleagues from diverse disciplines and backgrounds.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>How we help you Thrive:</strong> </p> <ul> <li>25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day  </li> <li>Bupa Healthcare</li> <li>Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave</li> <li>We have a Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm</li> <li>A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure</li> <li>Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests and development budgets and Wellbeing incentives and activities throughout the year </li> <li>Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme</li> <li>Life Assurance</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression. </p> <p>We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality. </p> <p>Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve.  This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.</p> <p><span data-teams="true">Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</span></p> <p>If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at ----- Please note that this contact is only for candidates who are requesting accommodation. title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer – AI-Native Software Development
description: <p>At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.</p> <p>We just unveiled JetBrains Central,  a platform for agent-driven software development that connects tools, agents, and infrastructure. It enables automated AI workflows to run, be monitored, and be managed across teams – with clear visibility into results, costs, and performance.</p> <p>JetBrains Central provides three core capabilities:<br><strong>Governance and control: </strong>Policy enforcement, identity and access management, observability, auditability, and cost attribution for agent-driven work. Some of these functionalities are already available via the <a href="http://console.jetbrains.cloud/">JetBrains Central Console</a>.<br><strong>Agent execution infrastructure: </strong>Cloud agent runtimes and computation provisioning that allow agents to run reliably across development environments.<br><strong>Agent optimization and context:</strong> Shared semantic context across repositories and projects, enabling agents to access relevant knowledge, and task routing to the most appropriate models or tools.</p> <p>Inside the Professional Services department, we are building a team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help our customers adopt AI-native development with JetBrains Central and enable JetBrains consulting partners to transform their customers’ AI-native software development lifecycle.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly with early adopter customers to deploy JetBrains Central platform into complex enterprise environments and help them move from experimental AI usage to governed, scalable AI-native development.</p> <p>You will act as a trusted advisor to customer engineering teams and consulting partners, while also mentoring other Forward Deployed Engineers and helping with complex deployments. In this role, you will help establish best practices for enterprise AI adoption and influence how organizations implement AI-driven software development.</p> <p>This role is often a strong fit for engineers who have previously served as Principal or Staff Engineers, Heads of Engineering, CTOs, or Solutions Architects and who enjoy working directly with customers while staying deeply involved with complex technical systems.</p> <p>This role combines consulting, architecture, and hands-on engineering. Your work in the field will directly influence how our platform evolves and how enterprises adopt AI-driven development.</p> <p>You will work directly with the world’s most innovative companies — our client base includes 420 of the Fortune 500 — ensuring they maximize the value of their JetBrains investments.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Deploy JetBrains Central platform into enterprise development environments, CI/CD systems, and internal developer platforms.</li> <li>Help organizations transition from ad-hoc AI experimentation to governed AI-native development workflows.</li> <li>Implement enterprise AI governance, including security policies, access management, and data privacy controls.</li> <li>Enable observability for AI-driven development to help organizations understand their AI usage and its impact on productivity, as well as their code-generation patterns.</li> <li>Design sustainable AI adoption strategies, including usage controls and cost visibility across multiple model providers.</li> <li>Integrate our cloud-based agent execution layer, allowing AI agents to run securely and at scale.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with JetBrains product teams to shape the platform based on real-world deployments and customer feedback.</li> <li>Create delivery frameworks and train JetBrains partners to deliver the desired scope of service.</li> <li>Mentor and support other Forward Deployed Engineers, sharing architectural expertise and helping to scale the team’s deployment practices.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You will thrive in this role if you are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A consultant at heart who can communicate effectively with both engineers and technical leadership.</li> <li>Able to see the whole picture of the software development lifecycle across developer tools, infrastructure, APIs, and cloud systems.</li> <li>Experienced at integrating complex software systems into enterprise environments.</li> <li>Curious about the future of AI agents and AI-native software development.</li> <li>Comfortable working with early adopters and overcoming ambiguous technical challenges.</li> <li>Motivated to mentor other engineers and contribute to building a new technical discipline.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in software-related projects, ideally in a customer-facing or consulting environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with Java or Python.</li> <li>Experience building or integrating developer platforms, infrastructure systems, or software solutions.</li> <li>Familiarity with modern development workflows (CI/CD, developer environments, internal developer platforms, etc.).</li> <li>Experience working directly with customers or technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate in fast-evolving technical environments.</li> <li>Ability and desire to travel to meet customers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>These would be a plus, but are not blockers</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience with industry-specific solutions (fintech, telco, retail, etc.)</li> <li>Experience with AI/LLM platforms, agent frameworks, or AI-assisted development tools.<br>Experience in solutions engineering, consulting, or forward-deployed engineering roles.</li> <li>Familiarity with the JetBrains ecosystem or developer productivity tooling.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-KP1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer</strong><br><br>We know great ideas can come from description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London | 💰£58,400 - £79,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p><strong>Our Business Hiring team⭐</strong></p> <p>We’re a small but mighty team, working on all the roles that are <strong><em>not</em></strong> Tech (Engineering, Product, Data or Design) and <strong><em>not</em></strong> in the world of Customer Service. In other companies, this is sometimes known as Corporate Functions. We touch on a huge variety of roles and so we talk to lots of different types of people every day. We're looking for support to boost our hiring efforts as the business scales.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <p><em>You’ll work with Hiring Managers to structure and run great hiring processes.</em></p> <ul> <li>Our hiring managers are often busy team leads and executives. They’ll need your help to identify what skills they’re looking for and how best to assess these. You’ll be confident challenging their thinking and asking the right questions to figure this out. You’ll own everything about the hiring process from beginning to end, and be skilled at convincing candidates to join us.</li> </ul> <p><em>You’ll care deeply about diversity and inclusiveness, and giving candidates an amazing experience</em></p> <ul> <li>We want to go the extra mile to make sure that every applicant to every job feels valued, respected and never wavers in their support for Monzo, whatever the outcome of their application. You’ll know where to find the right candidates from a range of backgrounds and have ideas about how to make sure they feel welcome at Monzo. And once we’ve decided we want to hire someone, you’ll move mountains in the background to make it an effortless, pleasant process, and keep that excitement burning.</li> </ul> <p><em>You’ll love sourcing and be great at spotting great talent in CVs</em></p> <ul> <li>You’ll be great at sourcing passive candidates yourself, and thinking about how to get the best people interested in Monzo. You’ll be comfortable managing large volumes of applications and picking out those that best fit our requirements.</li> </ul> <p><em>You’ll be passionate about making processes work better.</em></p> <ul> <li>We constantly refine our hiring processes to make them simpler and more effective. You’ll use data to work out what’s going well and where things could be better, and share your findings with other members of the hiring team so we can all improve.</li> </ul> <p><em>You might already have a specialist area but you’ll be comfortable working on any role</em></p> <ul> <li>We don’t mind if you’re a generalist recruiter, or if you already have a specialism, as long as you’re initially happy getting stuck into hiring any role that needs you. title: Associate Director, Clinical Supply Management (UK/EU)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong>About Summit:</strong></p> <p>Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.</p> <p>Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:</p> <p><strong>Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Colorectal Cancer (CRC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.</p> </li> </ul> <p><em>Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.</em></p> <p></p></div><p><strong><span style="font-size: 10.5pt;">Job Title: Sr. Medical Science Liaison</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-size: 10.5pt;">Location: Oxford, UK or Zug, Switzerland or Dublin, Ireland</span></strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Overview of Role:</strong></p> <p>The Associate Director, Clinical Supply Management supports the Senior Director in leading the full scope of global clinical supply chain responsibilities. The role translates functional strategy into disciplined execution across demand and supply planning, inventory management, packaging and labelling, distribution, returns and destruction, cross-border compliance, and GxP operations. Acting as a key delegate for the Senior Director, the (Associate) Director provides a layer of management for direct reports, establishes clear priorities and performance expectations, develops team capability, and drives operational excellence through standardized processes, meaningful metrics, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement. The role partners closely with Clinical Operations, Commercial, CMC, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Medical Affairs and Program Management, and oversees external partners including Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs), IXRS providers and specialist service providers.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Role and Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Supports the Senior Director in developing functional strategy, operating plans, budgets, governance and performance objectives across global clinical supply chain activities</li> <li>Leads day-to-day execution for new and ongoing studies and products, ensuring robust forecasting, supply planning, schedule adherence, inventory optimization, global logistics and sustained GxP compliance</li> <li>Serves as a delegate for the Senior Director in cross-functional forums, governance meetings, supplier reviews and issue escalation, providing clear recommendations and ensuring timely follow-through.</li> <li>Manages and develops direct reports, translating functional priorities into individual objectives, balancing workloads, coaching performance, supporting career development and ensuring appropriate succession and capability plans.</li> <li>Creates an effective management layer by coordinating team activities, reinforcing accountability, removing operational barriers and escalating material risks or decisions to the Senior Director.</li> <li>Overseeing the Clinical Supply Management (CSM) team, the Associate Director interprets complex clinical protocols, development plans and commercial demand forecasts, working with CMC and internal and external partners to develop packaging, labelling, supply and resupply strategies, timelines and plans.</li> <li>Supports the accountability of CSM team to oversee packaging, labelling, release, distribution, resupply, returns, reconciliation and destruction activities across global locations</li> <li>Develops and maintains supply project budgets, resource plans and integrated schedules, monitors performance and proactively resolves variances</li> <li>Manages CDMO and service-provider activities from RFP and contracting support through routine operations, troubleshooting, invoicing and performance management using defined KPIs and service expectations</li> <li>Supports IXRS selection, design, set-up, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), implementation and ongoing operational performance as required by IRT Management Team.</li> <li>Drives operational excellence by defining standard work, governance routines, KPIs and dashboards; uses trend and root-cause analysis to improve service, quality, cost, compliance and team productivity</li> <li>Leads continuous-improvement initiatives that streamline and harmonize processes, strengthen inspection readiness and embed sustainable ways of working</li> <li>Supports regulatory submissions, audits and inspections and ensures timely management of SOPs, change controls, deviations, investigations and CAPAs within the function</li> <li>Provides continuity of leadership and performs other responsibilities within the function as assigned</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BSc, MSc, engineering or pharmacy degree, or equivalent, with a minimum of 8+ years of progressive supply chain experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) environment</li> <li>Demonstrated success leading complex international clinical studies and product supply chains, with broad knowledge of regulatory and GMP requirements for IMP and commercial product packaging and supply</li> <li>Prior people-management experience, including setting objectives, coaching performance, developing talent, delegating effectively and managing through others</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into executable priorities, operating rhythms, metrics and measurable team outcomes</li> <li>Strong operational-excellence and continuous-improvement capability, including process standardization, KPI management, root-cause analysis and sustainable implementation of improvements</li> <li>Solid understanding of IXRS design specifications, set-up and UAT, together with proficiency in clinical supply planning and forecasting tools</li> <li>Strong project, budget, risk and resource-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality results</li> <li>Expertise in outsourcing, supplier governance, negotiation and performance management</li> <li>Experience building, scaling or improving end-to-end product supply chains and associated business processes</li> <li>Ability to operate as a trusted deputy to the Director, exercise sound judgement within delegated authority and escalate issues with clear options and recommendations</li> <li>Confident communicator able to influence all levels of the organization and build effective relationships with global colleagues, customers and suppliers</li> <li>Able to work independently with complex global problems while fostering inclusion, collaboration, accountability and effective team leadership</li> <li>Agile and resilient in a dynamic organization where priorities may change rapidly</li> <li>Knowledge of the drug development process and applicable FDA, EMA and PMDA expectations, including GMP, GCP, Annex 13 and relevant clinical trial requirements</li> <li>Technically proficient with industry-standard systems and tools and able to use technology, data and industry trends to improve efficiency and decision-making</li> <li>Knowledgeable of and compliant with SOPs, change controls, deviations, investigations and CAPAs</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>This is the pay for this position</p></div><div class="title">Pay Transparency</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$83,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$97,500 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p>Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. The total compensation package for this position may also include bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable variable compensation.</p> <p>Summit does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact Summit’s Talent Acquisition team at <a ----- ----- obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to Summit.</p> <p><span data-teams="true">Summit Therapeutics Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in creating and maintaining diverse environment. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training or promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Run design critiques and help others navigate projects with cohesive and thoughtful feedback. </li> <li><strong>Brand Guardian: </strong>Guide external agency partners on all things design and creative concepts.</li> <li><strong>Brand Design. </strong>Develop, evolve and maintain brand identities, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.</li> <li><strong>Hands-On Design: Figma FIRST. </strong>Roll up your sleeves and contribute directly to the design work, whether it’s crafting a standout campaign, refining our typography, or animating assets.</li> <li><strong>Typography. </strong>Utilize expert knowledge of typography to create visually appealing and readable designs.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration and Communication</strong>. Work closely with cross-functional teams, including marketing, product development, and project management, to deliver cohesive design solutions.</li> <li><strong>Creatively concept art direction</strong> and motion for in-app experiences with product teams.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record in design roles, with a strong portfolio demonstrating branding, art direction, product design, advertising campaigns and typography.</li> <li>You have experience in managing designers and leading design projects. </li> <li>You have strong typography skills.</li> <li>You demonstrate proficiency in design software such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects),<strong> Figma is a must. </strong>Motion skills, 3D programs, Ai toolings,  are a plus.</li> <li>You have excellent communication skills and the ability to articulate design concepts to both internal teams and senior management.</li> <li>You have strong stakeholder management skills.</li> <li>You're a creative problem solver who can manage multiple projects simultaneously and balance competing priorities.</li> <li>You're curious about AI tools and how they can enhance the creative process, ideally with some hands-on experience using them in your design work.</li> <li>You have experience in fast-paced tech startups or creative agencies working on global brands.</li> <li>You have experience in additional areas like web design, print design, storyboarding, art direction, film, and illustration.</li> <li>You’re obsessed with strategically designing within a brand, and have strong skills with evolving within a brand guideline. </li> <li>You have strong motion ideation and storyboarding skills.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£75,000 - £95,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <p><strong>30-minute call with our Recruiter, Tom</strong></p> <p><strong>1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Brand Design team. </strong></p> <p><strong>1-hour interview covering values & ways of working. </strong></p> <p> </p> <p>To help us understand your skills and experience, please include both your CV and a portfolio showcasing your work. We'd particularly love to see examples of projects you've led from start to finish, with a clear explanation of your individual role, responsibilities and contributions.<br><br>This process should take around 4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.
